levels.description: Gains SP when Infected Creatures are defeated, if said Creatures are defeated within its Attack Range, gains doubled SP; when skill is activated, grants a medium amount of <@ba.drop>Training Handbooks</> and a small amount of <@ba.drop>Packaged Cores</>, while generating several <@ba.enemy>Infused Originium Slugs</> on surrounding tiles (grants a small amount of <@ba.drop>Training Handbooks</> when defeated)
